propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts (transcript findings doc, transcript driver script, matrix budgeting script) from commit 556708771e were not reachable from origin/main and therefore unverifiable against main despite being cited in ticket acceptance criteria.

The diagnostic artifacts should be landed on main as durable evidence, following the established convention of paired live-diagnostic drivers and findings write-ups already present in docs/experiments/.

The completion-verifier exhibits a runaway tool-call loop (hitting max_consecutive_repeat guard at 66+ requests) that persists on current main, observable in test-infrastructure closes despite the guard successfully preventing unbounded loops.

The verifier's step-floor budget (currently flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480) allocates ~10x more budget than necessary; criteria-scaled budgeting (lever 1, ~6 steps per criterion) is grounded by measurement.
The runaway loop clusters on tickets with import/sys.path/collection criteria lacking single anchor symbols, pointing to context pre-selection as the root cause rather than a single code location.
